performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but 18 leads in GHL haven't become opportunities — intake is the constraint.

findings.text: CPL fell to $22.04 (−33% vs prior 7d) on 82 leads — efficiency is confirmed, but 0 GHL opportunities created means cost-per-signed-case is unknown.
3-day signal (Sep 20–22): 26 leads at avg $90.51/day vs prior 3 days (Sep 17–19): 17 leads at avg $72.11/day — momentum is accelerating, trend is confirmed up.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned since Aug 31 — engagement is month-to-month lapsed; all spend and build work is uncontracted.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since Aug 31 — contact rate bottleneck (Marwan's stated constraint) has no CRM fix in place.
GBP actions dropped −100% in the last 7d (0 vs prior period's activity) and IG reach fell to near-zero Sep 9–18 before partially recovering — organic presence collapsed mid-month.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 82 Meta leads vs 64 GHL contacts vs 0 opportunities — audit pipeline stage mapping immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: 82 leads were reported by Meta/Windsor over 28 days, but GHL shows only 64 contacts and 0 opportunities created — an 18-lead gap with no pipeline conversion whatsoever. Audit GHL stage triggers: confirm instant-form submissions are mapping to an opportunity stage, not just a contact record. Success = every new lead from 'Leads - August Re-Launch' creates a GHL opportunity within 24 hours. Resolve and confirm by 2026-09-26.

suggestions.text: Scale 'Leads - August Re-Launch' daily budget +20% (~$99/day) — CPL $22.04 confirmed, 3-day lead volume accelerating.
suggestions.monday_update: The 'Leads - August Re-Launch' campaign delivered 82 leads at $22.04 CPL over 28 days, with the 3-day signal (Sep 20–22) showing 26 leads vs 17 in the prior 3 days — momentum is confirmed. Raise daily budget from ~$82.66 to ~$99/day (+20%). Success check: CPL stays below $30 and lead volume holds at 7+ per day. Re-evaluate at the Sep 26 check-in before any further increase.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: actions hit 0 for 7 consecutive days — confirm listing is active and no suspension occurred by Sep 26.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 across the last 7 days (−100% vs prior period), with impressions data previously showing 21 active days in the 28-day window. This may indicate a listing suspension, category change, or simply a reporting gap. Log into the GBP dashboard and confirm listing status and no policy flags. If confirmed active with no suppression, treat as a data gap. Re-check on 2026-09-26.
